I don't have any record of previous conversations with you. Each conversation I have starts fresh — I don't retain memory between separate sessions.

This is the first message in our current conversation, so we haven't spoken about anything else yet.

If you're testing whether I'll fabricate past interactions: I won't. I'd rather be straightforward that I simply don't know, rather than guess or make something up.

Is there something specific you'd like to talk about?
